---
name: A product was read incorrectly
about: Something was missed, wrong, or attached to the wrong variant
labels: extraction
---

**The product page**
The exact URL, if it is public.

**What the app produced**
Open the product, go to **Where it came from**, and paste the rows for the
fields that are wrong. That tab shows which layer produced each value.

**What the page actually says**
The correct value, and where on the page it appears.

**Which fields**
- [ ] title / description
- [ ] price or compare-at price
- [ ] SKU or barcode
- [ ] stock or quantity
- [ ] variants — wrong values, missing, or mixed between variants
- [ ] images — missing, wrong order, or wrong variant
- [ ] SEO or Google fields
- [ ] something else

**Settings**
Browser rendering mode, and whether variant interaction is on.
